rev.t: Dress and pricing is ok, but if you buy more stuffs beware of hidden bills like elite enrollment which costs 250 rupees, they wont inform you about this extra bill and they wont give you manual bill receipt which will be sent to your phone online. If you won't check properly your money will be wasted.

We were double-charged for a dress. On top of that, they had an active promotional offer for men's T-shirts (Buy 2 for ₹199). However, the receipt showed they charged ₹199 for the first one and ₹249 for the second. When we brought this …
Not much of a collection, but good enough to visit during morning hours
